title: PoseConfig
description: JSONB configuration stored in exercises.pose_config. Drives ALL on-device pose estimation logic — rep counting, ROM measurement, and form checking. Source of truth; never change without notifying both engineers.

camera_view.description: Required camera orientation. 'side_either' lets the engine pick based on injured_side.

side_aware.description: When true the engine selects left/right landmark variants based on the patient's injured_side field.

landmarks.description: Map of semantic landmark names to MediaPipe BlazePose landmark indices (0-32). Include both left_ and right_ variants for side_aware exercises.

metrics.description: Computed values the engine derives from landmarks each frame. Referenced by phases and form_rules. Built-in metric 'rep_duration_ms' is always available without declaring it here.

phases.description: Named movement states. The engine evaluates each frame and labels it with the first matching phase.

rep_cycle.description: Ordered sequence of phase names that constitute one complete repetition, e.g. ['down','up','down'].

min_rep_duration_ms.description: Reps completed faster than this value (ms) automatically receive a 'too_fast' error.

form_rules.description: Ordered list of checks run each frame. First violation wins for a given error id per rep.

min_pose_confidence.description: Frames where any required landmark has a visibility score below this value are skipped and may trigger 'low_confidence'.

ThresholdCheck.description: Machine-readable threshold condition on a named metric.

metric.description: Name of metric from the metrics array, or the built-in 'rep_duration_ms'.

value.description: Threshold value. For 'between', the lower bound.

value_max.description: Upper bound (required only when operator is 'between').

Metric.description: A scalar value the engine computes per-frame from BlazePose landmarks.

oneOf.description: Angle metric: computes the interior angle (degrees) at the pivot landmark.

name.description: Unique name; referenced by phases and form_rules.

joints.description: Three landmark names: [proximal, pivot, distal]. Angle is measured at pivot.

oneOf.description: Vertical delta metric: signed vertical distance (normalized 0-1 screen coords, positive = upward) between two landmarks.

Phase.description: A named movement state defined by a single metric threshold.

FormRule.description: A form-quality check that fires an error code and surfaces a coaching cue.

id.description: Error code id (must match an entry in error_codes.md).

cue.description: Plain-English coaching cue displayed to the patient when this rule fires.
